ideas.pitch: An offline-first, location-aware AR audio guide and heritage trail planner for Jammu's historic temples and Mubarak Mandi complex.
ideas.title: JammuTrek AI Heritage Guide
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Jammu's tourism development goals and provides a polished, working mobile-web demo with zero friction for foreign or domestic pilgrims.

ideas.pitch: A real-time IoT waste bin fill-level monitoring and dynamic truck routing dashboard for Jammu municipal workers.
ideas.title: CleanJammu Municipal Smart Bin Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent everyday civic headache in Jammu with clear, quantifiable efficiency metrics that appeal directly to municipal evaluators.

ideas.pitch: A real-time disaster management and crowd-sourced safe shelter routing platform tailored for Jammu's monsoon and hilly terrain risks.
ideas.title: JammuTawi Flood & Landslide Early Warning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven patterns from award-winning disaster response apps by pairing live data ingestion with clear, actionable evacuation instructions for citizens.

ideas.pitch: A unified commuter dashboard and crowdsourced feeder-bus tracker addressing Jammu's suburban and intra-city transit bottlenecks.
ideas.title: Jammu Mobility Transit Connect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on everyday transit infrastructure, giving judges an immediately testable tool for local commuter optimization.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and street-level imagery analysis tool to track urban green space health and plan neighborhood afforestation in Jammu.
ideas.problem_statement: Urban Planning, Green Spaces & Public Realm
ideas.title: GreenJammu Canopy Mapper
ideas.track: Urban Planning, Green Spaces & Public Realm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines environmental sustainability metrics with a sleek geospatial dashboard, making it highly attractive for municipal green policy planners.
